description: This file defines classes and functions for managing distributed timers, including TimerRequest, TimerClient, RequestQueue, TimerServer, and utility functions for configuring and using timers within a distributed system.

classes.name: TimerRequest
classes.description: Represents a countdown timer request with worker ID, scope ID, and expiration time.

classes.name: TimerClient
classes.description: Abstract base class for clients that acquire and release timers.

classes.name: RequestQueue
classes.description: Abstract base class for a queue holding timer requests.

classes.name: TimerServer
classes.description: Abstract base class for a server that manages timers, reaps workers, and handles expired timers.

methods.name: register_timers
methods.description: Registers incoming timer requests with the server.

methods.name: clear_timers
methods.description: Clears all timers for specified worker IDs.

methods.name: get_expired_timers
methods.description: Returns all expired timers up to a given deadline.

methods.name: _reap_worker
methods.description: Reaps a specific worker; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: _reap_worker_no_throw
methods.description: Calls _reap_worker and catches exceptions, considering the worker reaped if an exception occurs.

methods.name: _watchdog_loop
methods.description: Main loop for the watchdog thread to process timers and reaping.

methods.name: _run_watchdog
methods.description: Performs a single iteration of the watchdog: fetching requests, registering timers, and reaping expired workers.

methods.name: _get_scopes
methods.description: Extracts scope IDs from timer requests.
